dog.description_text: Meet Pablo — New Arrival! Pablo just arrived and is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about his time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/r/sites/GRP_NYC_Foster/Shared%20Documents/Forms/AllItems.aspx?id=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral%2FPablo%20%2D%20About%20Me%2Epdf&parent=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral&p=true&share=cQoLU4jjJWpOQbsMr%5FkxEjp0EgUD3R88C5ixodQcD9UFeX2onA His foster says he is friendly, spunky, and energetic. He loves to cuddle and play , and learn new things . He has been neutered, vaccinated, microchipped, and has had preventative treatments to ensure he is ready for his next steps. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
